SELECT date(started_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM trip WHERE started_at >= '2025-01-01' AND started_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY date(started_at) ORDER BY trip_count DESC, day ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT s.city, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.resolved_on IS NOT NULL THEN m.cost END), 0) AS total_resolved_cost FROM station s LEFT JOIN bike b ON b.station_id = s.station_id LEFT JOIN maintenance m ON m.bike_id = b.bike_id AND m.resolved_on IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY s.city
SELECT s.name FROM station s JOIN bike b ON b.station_id = s.station_id GROUP BY s.station_id, s.name, s.capacity HAVING COUNT(b.bike_id) > s.capacity / 2.0
